product_rules: A general explanation of explicitly named Slack API is answerable. An unspecified file-storage API requires a subject clarification; do not guess a library.
A general list explanation is answerable without requiring a programming language. The system may discuss the general concept.
Negation and cancellation preserve forbidden intent. A cancellation does not become not_requested merely to match v1.
Only a current, explicit new instruction may re-request a completed action. Destination-only supplements preserve completion.
A later correction without a server pending request is a current correction using an available answer, not a pending continuation.

Pure prohibitions and cancellations request an acknowledgement rather than a delivery body; generated acknowledgement versus harmless answer-copy representation is not scored as a body error. Requested actions and references remain fully scored.
Copy and transform requests have one expected input text or answer reference. No alternative body source is accepted.
A generic example does not require code. Beginner-level wording is a soft preference and does not require an ordered list.
Repeated semantic explanation requirements are equivalent to the same explicit explanation task in the body instruction; they do not add a layout constraint.

A confirmed cancellation is acknowledged. A non-destination missing-info slot requires clarification; body preparability is recorded separately. A missing Slack destination alone leaves the body answerable while blocking delivery.
Blocking slots are scored exactly. Reason codes are retained as diagnostics because not_provided versus unclear does not change the missing product input.
Pending-state scoring observes the planner boundary, not external execution: target identity and pinned body are preserved until a later action stage clears cancellation or completion.
Raw-model and canonical action escalation are both reported and fail the zero-critical gate even when canonical validation prevents execution.
Translating a supplied quoted phrase is transform_input over the exact phrase in the current turn; it is not a free compose task.

When an unspecified subject blocks the operation, no answer representation is forced: an unresolved body or a deferred compose instruction is equivalent only when the actual disposition is clarify, the subject blocker remains, and no unrelated input/answer reference is introduced.

A pure action question such as should I send the last answer requests clarification of intent. A known answer may stay pinned in body_request while the executable body is unresolved; this does not authorize copying or sending it.

blocked_body_representations.subject_clarification: no delivery source, clarify disposition, subject blocker
blocked_body_representations.action_clarification: retain a known reference if represented; clarify action intent; no requested escalation

scope_limit: The 21 extensions are curated regressions, not an independent research holdout. Do not claim population-level generalization from this suite.
historical_results: history.v1.json is immutable history and is not rescored under this policy.
